resources.string: Experimental rootless Themes recovery
Experimental: bypassing the downgrade block is not guaranteed. Installation can fail even after removal.

Prepare downloads Themes 3.0.5.6 and saves the installed 3.4.1.23 base/split APKs and MTZ Studio library only. It does NOT fully back up Themes private data, themes, or settings. Export the Studio ZIP separately.
Requires the supported Global baseline, Android user 0 and ADB Shizuku/Shevery. No package is removed during preparation.
Reading recovery journal…
App-private recovery directory: %1$s
Prepare and verify backup
Export Studio library ZIP
Export recovery ZIP (APK set + Studio library)
The Studio backup ZIP is unavailable in the app recovery directory.
Open Android backup settings
Manually back up Themes in HyperOS if your device supports it. This opens Android privacy settings, not a direct HyperOS backup page; check your device’s backup options yourself.
Android backup settings could not be opened.
To install an older Themes version, the current version will be removed and your themes will be deleted.

Themes app data and settings will be deleted. The Studio ZIP does not contain all Themes data. The older APK may still fail to install; install-existing does not restore your data or guarantee the factory version.
Remove and install older version
Remove the current Themes package and delete its themes, app data, and settings? The Studio ZIP is not a full Themes backup. Installing 3.0.5.6 may still fail. This action starts only if you confirm.
An interrupted or failed operation may have left Themes unavailable. Recovery is manual and will not restore private data or guarantee the factory version.
Re-enable existing package
Try to re-enable the existing Themes package? This may fail and does not restore deleted data or guarantee the factory version. No recovery command runs until you confirm.
Working… Keep the app running until the operation finishes.
